summary: The filing is an 8-K by Kewaunee Scientific Corporation announcing only the planned release of its Q4 and fiscal year 2026 earnings results on June 23, 2026. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change—is described. The furnished press release provides the earnings date and basic business background. This is a routine earnings schedule announcement, not a special situation, so the category is "None."
